title: DiagnosticInterviewerOutput
description: Structured output of the Diagnostic interviewer (AGENTS.md Role 1) for a single turn, plus the row it accumulates into diagnostic_intake (BLUEPRINT.md §4.1).

next_question.description: Must match a question bank entry keyed by tree_node_id — the model cannot free-write a question. null once the tree reaches a terminal branch (diagnostic complete).

tree_node_id.description: The node the conversation is now at — the node just answered when terminal, the newly-entered node otherwise.

intake_record.description: Accumulated fields written to diagnostic_intake once the tree reaches a terminal node.

rock_proposal.description: A specific, difficult 90-day rock statement (PRD §6 row 7 / content/protocols/07-goal-setting-rock.md), synthesized from the full intake — present only on the terminal turn, editable by the user before it's written to the rock table.
